decisions.reason: As an upgraded and renamed version of an already well-liked trommel screen, A looks like a low-uncertainty extension of the core portfolio, so the option value of keeping it available exceeds its likely carrying cost.

The 2019 rollout of the whole AK line with Stage V engine technology signals continued investment and regulatory adaptation, which for a mature German machinery maker points to a committed product line rather than an experiment to abandon.

C still has some unresolved market uncertainty because the evidence is thinner than for B or F, but its move from a mention to a dedicated page and its strong fit with the firm’s mobile recycling machinery support keeping the option open.

F shows the strongest commitment and clearest positive signal, with a new generation, several models, and reference use cases in a strategic stationary segment, so management would be unlikely to withdraw it soon.
